# Provider fixtures

This directory contains one sanitized-real Claude usage response. Its strings, numbers, dates, names, balances, and reset values are deterministic synthetic values; only the response structure and JSON value types remain from the authorized capture.

The Codex fixture remains unavailable because its single authorized capture attempt failed without producing a response fixture. The machine-checked status is in `../evidence/provider-fixtures.json`; `unavailable` does not certify provider compatibility and keeps that human release proof open.
